name: Match referee
design: Athletic muscular adult female with ash-grey mottled hide, strong broad four-mandibled face, black dreadlocks tied tightly at nape. Short ochre training-style official tunic, thick black diagonal cloth sash, wrapped forearms and legs, two simple belt cases. Holds a folded dark-gold signal pennant on short rounded pole beside right thigh, left palm gently raised near chest to signal pause. No blade or armor.
